description: SEARCH-page PLA SKUs responded/served for search queries on a marketplace over a period: for each search keyword, serving cache_type (relevancy algorithm), SKU id and product attributes (product name, brand, e_product_type category), returns currency-converted spend and impressions. Used to investigate keyword-to-SKU irrelevancy. Optionally filter by keyword (search query), campaign_id, or product_name.

keyword.description: The normalised search query the shopper typed (lower-cased, stripped of bracket/quote/comma chars).

cache_type.description: The OnlineSales relevancy algorithm / cache that served this SKU for the keyword (e.g. exact, broad, auto match).

sku_id.description: Identifier of the SKU that was responded/served for the search query.

product_name.description: Product name of the served SKU (from the marketplace product-dimensions table).

category.description: Product category (e_product_type) of the served SKU.

campaign_id.description: Campaign that served the SKU. Optional per-call filter; not required to return rows.

spend.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(TIMESTAMP(impr.response_timestamp_utc), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN COALESCE(impr.bid, 0) * scc.conversion_factor ELSE 0 END), 0)
spend.description: Ad spend on the served SKU for the keyword, converted to the marketplace currency (bid * conversion_factor).

impressions.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(TIMESTAMP(impr.response_timestamp_utc), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND impr.unique_impressions > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
impressions.description: Number of responses for this SKU/keyword that rendered at least one unique impression.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.os_product_ads_response_to_impressions_mapping` AS impr JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.marketplace_clients` AS mc ON mc.marketplace_client_id = impr.marketplace_client_id JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.oltp_merchandise_product_dimensions___SP_MARKETPLACE_CLIENT_ID__` AS mpd ON mpd.sku_id = impr.sku_id LEFT JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.static_currency_conversion` AS scc ON scc.from_currency = 'USD' AND scc.to_currency = mc.currency WHERE mc.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND mc.marketplace_client_id = '__SP_MARKETPLACE_CLIENT_ID__' AND DATE(TIMESTAMP(impr.response_timestamp_utc), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND impr.page_type = 'SEARCH' AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__;
